Note: The delay time cooked variable is a float, m_FDelayInSamples rather than an integer number of samples. This is because we will allow _fractional delay_ in a future version of the module. For now, though, we will treat it as an integer.

Cooking the feedback value is easy—just divide by 100 to convert the percent to a raw multiplier.

The same thing is true for the wet level value. In this project, we'll introduce the concept of a cooking function to handle the work. Because we are planning on using this plug-in as a module for future development, it will be a good idea. From this point on, you should get in the habit of making a cooking function. In this case, we will keep it simple and have the cooking function recalculate all the plug-in's variables regardless of which ones actually change. This is an effort to educate first. You
